existingReason: typed-generics and callback: PkDataTable<TItem> is a thin typed wrapper; Load runs through PkCallbackSlot, rows and cell slots come from typed columns (issue 801 step 5) Missing generator features: @typeparam generation (a typed component), a callback parameter kind (a typed delegate that the generator hands to the element as a PkCallbackSlot, with an adapter from the element's argument and result to the delegate), and typed columns turned into the config JSON with per-row cell slots.

params.name: Config
params.note: Not a parameter of the component: PkDataTable<TItem> sends its typed parameters (Columns, PageSize, PageSizeOptions, SortKey, Descending, Searchable, Search, SearchPlaceholder, SearchLabel, SearchDebounceMs, PagerLabel, Label, Caption, EmptyText, NoResultsText, LoadErrorText, AddLabel) as the element's plain props; config stays the element's fallback only.

params.name: SelectPageOnly
params.note: Suppresses the Select all N rows offer; the header checkbox still selects the page and SelectScope stays page.

params.name: Selected
params.note: The ids of the selected rows across every page and search; follows OnSelect.

params.name: SelectScope
params.note: page or all: all after the user chose Select all N rows; OnSelect then carries the query (Scope, Query, read with PkSelectQuery.ToRequest) to run the bulk action against on the server. No ids of other pages are ever sent.

notes: PkDataTable<TItem> (Components/PkDataTable.razor) wraps pk-data-table 1:1: Load is a callback property, so the component hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot, bridge setCallback) exactly as PkListPage does; cell templates fill the cell-<id>-<key> slots; AddLabel is the element's add-label and OnAdd its pk-add; EmptyContent, BulkContent and ToolbarContent fill the empty, bulk and actions slots; OnSelect, SelectedChanged and OnRowClick come from pk-select and pk-row-click. A selection of 64 rows or more of the loaded page crosses the wire as runs of row indexes (data-pk-ranges).
